title: Application of artificial intelligence (AI) methods for the analysis of ultrasound images and for the evaluation and generation of ultrasound reports
summary: In this project, we are investigating the use of artificial intelligence (AI) methods for the automated analysis of liver ultrasound examinations. To this end, we are using ultrasound images and videos collected as part of routine clinical care at the Department of Gastroenterology, Hepatology, and Infectious Diseases at the University Hospital Düsseldorf. The goal is to train AI algorithms that can assist physicians in the future with the detection, classification, and description of liver abnormalities.
conditions: Secondary malignant neoplasm of liver and intrahepatic bile duct
Fatty (change of) liver, not elsewhere classified

interventions.name: A retrospective analysis of all patients who underwent a liver ultrasound scan at the Department of Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Infectious Diseases at Düsseldorf University Hospital between 2015 and 2025.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Examination Type:
Liver ultrasound in B-mode and contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS), regardless of device type or manufacturer

Diagnoses (ICD-10):
C22.0 (HCC), C78.7 (liver metastases), K76.0 (steatosis hepatis), K74 (liver fibrosis/cirrhosis), D13.4 (liver adenoma), K76.8 (FNH, hemangioma, cysts), other focal liver lesions

Age:
Adult patients (≥18 years) at the time of the examination

Time period:
January 1, 2015 – December 31, 2025

Treatment setting:
Inpatient and outpatient

Facility:
Department of Gastroenterology, Hepatology, and Infectious Diseases, UKD Düsseldorf
Exclusion criteria:
Objection:
Patients who have expressly objected to the use of their research data

Image Quality:
Examinations with image quality that cannot be evaluated
